title: Theater als „Spiel- und Spiegelform“ jüdischer Erfahrung
summary: The book explores how the entry of Jews into modern Viennese society functioned "as theater" and with theatrical means, developing a praxeology of Jewish belonging and difference. Four studies address Jewish experiences of Modernity between performing and observing, social exposition and anti-Semitic oppression as modes of the theatrical. Theater thus unfolds as a multi-layered cultural practice as well as a "play and mirror form of life" (Stefan Zweig).
